title: For all the female patient age 50 and above, who has abnormal red blood cel
question:
For all the female patient age 50 and above, who has abnormal red blood cell count. State if they were admitted to hospital.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: female patient refers to Sex = 'F'; age 50 and above = SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(Birthday)) > = 50; abnormal red blood cell count refers to RBC < = 3.5 or RBC > = 6.0; Admission = '+' means the patient was admitted to the hospital; Admission = '-' means the patient was not admitted to the hospital;

prediction.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.XCL_063 FROM Patient AS "p" JOIN Laboratory AS "l" ON "p".XCL_058 = "l".XCL_014 WHERE p.XCL_059 = 'F' AND (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', p.XCL_060)) >= 50 AND (l.XCL_031 <= 3.5 OR l.XCL_031 >= 6.0)

arguments.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.XCL_063
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
WHERE p.XCL_059 = 'F'
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.XCL_060)) >= 50
  AND (l.XCL_031 <= 3.5 OR l.XCL_031 >= 6.0);
